from decimal import Decimal

    ({'id': 'order,\"quoted\"\\nnext', 'total': Decimal('12345678901234567890.12'), 'currency': 'U,\"S\"\\nD'}, '12345678901234567890.12'),

    assert list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(render_order(order)))) == [
        ['id', 'total', 'currency'],
        [str(order['id']), total, order['currency']],
    ]
assert render_order(cases[0][0]) == 'id,total,currency\\r\\n17,12.30,USD\\r\\n'
